# Unify Consulting () - SVP Technical Pre-Sales and Enterprise Solution Architecture briefing packet

## JD Complement
The role likely exists to bridge a consulting firm’s advisory brand with repeatable, technically credible solution shaping. The operating tension is not “build the best architecture,” but “translate strategy into a buyer-ready,
implementable path that can be sold, scoped, and delivered without losing trust.”

## Company DNA & Operating Model
Unify Consulting is a services-led, AI management consulting firm with a human-centered positioning. Its core promise is to connect strategy, AI, data, and people to drive transformation at scale.

The archetype is hybrid consulting plus implementation enablement:
- It wins through advisory credibility, technical depth, and execution support rather than software IP alone.
- It appears to lean on complex enterprise transformation work where stakeholder alignment matters as much as architecture.
- The central tension for this role is to keep solutioning concrete enough for commercial pursuit work while preserving the firm’s consultative, high-trust posture.

## Company Strategy & Operating Pressure
Verified company facts point to a founded-in-2006 consulting business based in Kirkland with multi-location presence. Public descriptions frame it as a flexible alternative to larger firms, which implies pressure to be both specialized and
scalable.

That creates a positioning challenge:
- Compete against larger consultancies on speed, specificity, and senior attention.
- Show enough technical rigor to win enterprise modernization and AI/data programs.
- Convert broad transformation language into a sharper, repeatable pursuit motion.

For this role, the likely decision-rights shift is from bespoke advisory storytelling toward reusable solution patterns, clearer qualification, and tighter pre-sales-to-delivery continuity.

## Leadership & Stakeholder Map
Verified leadership detail is limited in the available record, so avoid over-claiming named org structure. The likely stakeholder map is still clear for a firm like this:
- Consulting leadership for commercial prioritization and margin discipline.
- Delivery leaders for feasibility, staffing, and handoff quality.
- Practice leads across AI, data, cloud, and Salesforce-related work.
- Partner-facing functions where alliances influence pipeline and solution credibility.
- Client executives who need business outcomes, not technical novelty.

## AI, Data, Platform, Architecture Signals
Unify’s public positioning emphasizes AI, data, and people together, which suggests an operating model that values adoption and change management alongside technical design.

Relevant platform signals include:
- Advanced Salesforce solutions are part of the firm’s stated solution set.
- Named Salesforce surfaces include Data Cloud, Experience Cloud, Service Cloud, and Billing Cloud.
- The firm also presents itself as an AI management consulting firm, implying architecture work that must connect data, workflow, and user experience.

For this role, the architecture signal is not pure infrastructure depth; it is enterprise solution shaping across CRM, data, and AI-enabled business processes.

## Partnership / Ecosystem Motion
Partnership motion is material here. Unify explicitly positions partnerships and alliances as part of how it brings technology solutions to clients.

Verified ecosystem signals include:
- Partnerships with digital and cloud technology leaders.
- A published Google Cloud partnership page.
- A broader partner ecosystem with multiple technology and channel relationships.

That implies a co-sell and joint-solution environment where technical pre-sales must be fluent in partner roadmaps, implementation boundaries, and how to package a credible joint offer.

## Recent Events & Urgency
The available record shows a firm that is actively framing itself around AI-driven transformation and partner-enabled delivery. The urgency for this role likely comes from market pressure to turn that positioning into repeatable enterprise
wins.

The practical pressure points are:
- Buyers expect AI and data programs to be tied to measurable business value.
- Consulting firms must show implementation realism, not just strategy language.
- Partner ecosystems increasingly shape credibility in cloud and platform-led pursuits.

## apps_rg Positioning Themes (targeting only, not proof)
- Enterprise consulting that blends strategy, AI, data, and delivery
- Pre-sales leadership in services-led transformation environments
- Solution architecture that supports both pursuit and implementation
- Cloud and platform partnership fluency
- Salesforce-adjacent enterprise modernization exposure
- Executive-facing discovery and business-value framing
- Reusable solution patterns in complex client environments
- Handoff discipline between sales, architecture, and delivery

## apps_lic Outreach Angles (targeting only, not proof)
- Reference the firm’s strategy-plus-execution positioning, not generic consulting language
- Mention interest in how they turn AI and data narratives into buyer-ready solution paths
- Ask how they balance partner-led credibility with firm-owned solution design
- Connect to cloud and Salesforce ecosystem motions where joint value matters
- Signal familiarity with consulting firms that need repeatable architecture without losing customization

## Do Not Use As Proof
The JD and this briefing are targeting inputs only. Candidate claims must come from the governed resume/proof graph.
